description: This file implements the DeepSleepController class and related utilities for managing deep sleep modes, wakeup reasons, and sleep scheduling in a device firmware or embedded system environment.

classes.name: DeepSleepWakeupSettings
classes.description: Provides configuration and utility functions for managing wakeup timing and time zone adjustments.

classes.name: DeepSleepController
classes.description: Manages deep sleep operations, including entering sleep mode, scheduling wakeups, and handling wakeup reasons.

methods.name: DeepSleepWakeupSettings::getTZDiffInSec
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone difference in seconds based on system settings.

methods.name: DeepSleepWakeupSettings::initializeTimeZone
methods.description: Initializes the mapping of timezone strings to internal timezone values.

methods.name: DeepSleepWakeupSettings::secure_random
methods.description: Generates a secure random number using /dev/urandom.

methods.name: DeepSleepWakeupSettings::getWakeupTime
methods.description: Calculates the wakeup time in seconds, considering overrides, current time, and randomness.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::Activate
methods.description: Activates deep sleep mode with specified timeout and standby mode.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates deep sleep mode and wakes the device.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::read_integer_conf
methods.description: Reads an integer configuration value from a file.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::enterDeepSleepDelayed
methods.description: Enters deep sleep after a delay, handling wakeup reasons and errors.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::enterDeepSleepNow
methods.description: Immediately attempts to put the device into deep sleep, with retries.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::deepSleepTimerWakeup
methods.description: Handles wakeup due to timer expiration, logs reason, and notifies parent.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::performActivate
methods.description: Performs the activation sequence for deep sleep, including configuration overrides.
